items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Percy Umphrey. Yeah, Percy Umphrey. He went with me, old man Joe Howard, Eddie Jones with Wicked Widow.

ctx.x: His people were there, his mother I think, and I dead hit him, you understand, and put a few dollars on him, which he played, you understand, and Poissy, uh, uh. Percy Umphrey. Percy Umphrey. Yeah, Percy Umphrey. He went with me, old man Joe Howard, Eddie Jones with Wicked Widow.
Howard played second trumpet then, not the trumpet. No, no, he played the tuba.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Old man Joe Howard made that first trip with me, playing the bass. And Louie came over to see him. And Percy, he was there too, Percy.

ctx.x: At the Warwick Hall. At the Warwick Hall. Where was Louie?

Well, Louie came over and visited. He knew old man Joe Howard at that time. Old man Joe Howard made that first trip with me, playing the bass. And Louie came over to see him. And Percy, he was there too, Percy. Edwin Washington. Oh, it could be an Edwin.
What was Percy playing? Second trumpet. Percy Humphrey. Percy Humphrey.
